audit.why: Aurora owns levels 1-5 on range and the hop; from 6 it is Skill. Matches the packet levelChart and 58.97% over 39 games, and matches the mirror file sejuani__aurora.json.
Aurora's R is Between Worlds. A fabricated name at the level-6 spike is the worst place for one.
audit.corrected: Name fixed and the spike now states what actually changes at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tells you to 'trade around Permafrost's cooldown'. Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown — it is not a window and never will be.
audit.why: Permafrost (E, 1.5s, 560 range) only stuns a target already at maximum Frost stacks, and Frost comes from Winter's Wrath (W, 9s at rank 1 down to 5s). The real punishable cooldown is Winter's Wrath, not the stun. Separately, Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, so The Weirding's slow and Between Worlds' slow do nothing to her while it holds — you have to break the armor with damage first. And Glacial Prison (R, 120s at rank 1) reveals stealth, so Across the Veil's invisibility is not an escape from it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt around Winter's Wrath with the real numbers; Frost Armor slow immunity and the Glacial Prison stealth reveal both stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.you[2] assert Between Worlds makes Aurora untargetable. Riot's text for Between Worlds gives a shockwave, a slow zone and a side-to-side teleport — no untargetability. The invisibility in Aurora's kit is on Across the Veil.
audit.why: Telling a player they are untargetable inside their own ult will get them killed holding still in it. The verified mechanic is the teleport and the slow.
audit.corrected: Both lines rewritten to the teleport and slow, and the Glacial Prison stealth reveal added where it matters.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Winter's Wrath (9s rank 1, 5s maxed) is the real window — Permafrost is 1.5s and only stuns you at max Frost, so deny the stacks, not the stun. - Frost Armor makes her slow-immune: your E and R slows do nothing until it breaks.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Permafrost's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: trade after Winter's Wrath so she cannot stack Frost into the stun. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sejuani's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Between Worlds zones the all-in and its teleport wins her spacing. Glacial Prison reveals stealth, so Across the Veil is no escape from it.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — build your teamfight around that. Sejuani carry threat: 5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Between Worlds zones the whole all-in — build your teamfight around that. Sejuani carry threat: 5/10 — she never out-damages you, she only becomes harder to kill.

edits.before: Between Worlds (R) lets you walk through the wall and become untargetable to anything outside the rift, so even a perfectly aimed Glacial Prison whiffs — drop the rift on her, recast Q for the double hit, and your W (Across the Veil) resets on the takedown.
edits.after: Between Worlds (R) leaves a slow zone you can teleport across, so you win her spacing outright — but Glacial Prison reveals stealth, so Across the Veil's invisibility will not shake it. Drop the rift on her and recast Q through her for the double hit.

edits.before: Close the game on your early poke lead — your R untargetability beats her ult 1v1, and she only gets tankier and more teamfight-relevant the longer it goes
edits.after: Close the game on your early poke lead — her 120s Glacial Prison is her only 1v1 answer, and she only gets tankier and more teamfight-relevant the longer it goes

notes: Aurora's Between Worlds is described across this champion's entries as granting untargetability. Riot's Data Dragon text gives it a shockwave, a slow zone and a side-to-side teleport only — the invisibility in her kit is on Across the Veil. I corrected the two Sejuani instances but the claim is champion-wide and wants a scripted pass. The mirror sejuani__aurora.json reaches the same conclusion from the other side.
